diff:
diff --git a/debian/changelog b/debian/changelog
index c208018..b17a4d0 100644
--- a/debian/changelog
+++ b/debian/changelog
@@ -1,3 +1,11 @@
+resource-agents (1:4.7.0-1ubuntu7.5) jammy; urgency=medium
+
+  * d/t/{control,run-ocft}: switch to generic kernel if required kernel
+    modules are missing for ocft tests (iscsi, nfsd).
+    (LP: #2169706)
+
+ -- Hector Cao <hector.cao@canonical.com>  Thu, 08 Oct 2026 17:36:23 +0200
+
 resource-agents (1:4.7.0-1ubuntu7.4) jammy; urgency=medium
 
   * d/p/docker-29-cli.patch: fix image existence check for docker >= 29
diff --git a/debian/tests/control b/debian/tests/control
index 4b83b1d..3f1e33b 100644
--- a/debian/tests/control
+++ b/debian/tests/control
@@ -54,4 +54,4 @@ Restrictions: needs-root, isolation-machine
 
 Test-Command: debian/tests/run-ocft iscsi
 Depends: resource-agents, open-iscsi, targetcli-fb, openssl
-Restrictions: needs-root, isolation-machine
+Restrictions: needs-root, isolation-machine, needs-reboot, allow-stderr
diff --git a/debian/tests/run-ocft b/debian/tests/run-ocft
index f820fce..4d72d6c 100755
--- a/debian/tests/run-ocft
+++ b/debian/tests/run-ocft
@@ -2,8 +2,63 @@
 
 set -e
 
+is_non_generic_kernel () {
+  case "$(uname -r)" in
+    *-generic) return 1 ;;
+    *) return 0 ;;
+  esac
+}
+
+switch_to_generic_kernel () {
+  is_non_generic_kernel || return 1
+
+  apt-get update
+
+  # install generic and remove the current kernel
+  # assuming that there is only one kernel installed
+  cur_kernel=$(uname -r)
+  DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y linux-generic || return 1
+  DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get purge -y linux-image-${cur_kernel} linux-modules-${cur_kernel} || true
+
+  return 0
+}
+
+# setup the right kernel for the NFS and iSCSI tests
+# since they require kernel modules (nfsd and iscsi_target_mod)
+setup_kernel_modules () {
+  # check if need to switch to generic kernel
+  modprobe nfsd && modprobe iscsi_target_mod && return 0
+
+  # skip if no reboot capability
+  if ! test -x /tmp/autopkgtest-reboot; then
+    echo "Kernel module setup requires autopkgtest reboot support" >&2
+    return 1
+  fi
+
+  # skip if at resume phase
+  if test "${AUTOPKGTEST_REBOOT_MARK:-}" = generic-kernel; then
+    echo "Generic kernel was not booted after reboot" >&2
+    return 1
+  fi
+
+  # switch to generic kernel and reboot
+  if switch_to_generic_kernel; then
+    /tmp/autopkgtest-reboot generic-kernel
+  fi
+
+  return 0
+}
+
 AGENT=$1
 
+# NFS and iSCSI tests need kernel modules that might not be available
+# in the current kernel
+case "$AGENT" in
+  nfsserver|iscsi)
+    setup_kernel_modules 2>&1 || echo "Warning: kernel module setup failed; keep going ..."
+    ;;
+esac
+
 cleanup () {
   ocft clean $AGENT
 }
